own_solution.law: The de Broglie relation is lambda = h/p. Non-relativistically, K = p²/(2m), so lambda = hc/sqrt(2(mc²)K). With K = 150 eV, lambda = 1240/sqrt(2 × 511000 × 150) nm.
assumptions: Use the stipulated non-relativistic kinetic-energy relation.
Evaluate the wavelength after all stated acceleration, with no subsequent energy change.

notes: Both relevant sentences increase the electron's kinetic energy to 250 eV, giving lambda = 1240/sqrt(2 × 511000 × 250) = 0.0775758 nm. The proton in another building has no specified physical coupling to the electron. All three sentences specify the same added kinetic energy, 100 eV; the first two are equivalent paraphrases, while the third attaches that energy to a separate particle.
